Monthly point climate anomalies use ERA5 via Open-Meteo, comparing each complete month with the same calendar month in 1991–2020. Temperature is a difference in °C; rainfall is a percentage difference. These are gridded reanalysis estimates, not national averages. Seven-day forecasts are loaded separately on demand.
% · FAO/OWID and UN/OWID. Climate compar: % · FAO/OWID and UN/OWID. Climate comparisons are separate. Consumption, trade, and food stocks are not included.
ERA5 monthly temperature and rainfall co: ERA5 monthly temperature and rainfall compared with 1991–2020 at one monitoring point per country. Seven-day forecasts are loaded separately on demand.

One monitoring point, not a national ave: One monitoring point, not a national average. ERA5 reanalysis combines observations and a weather model; it is not a field measurement.
Temperature anomaly = monthly mean tempe: Temperature anomaly = monthly mean temperature minus the mean for the same month in 1991–2020.
Rainfall change = (monthly rainfall minu: Rainfall change = (monthly rainfall minus baseline rainfall) divided by baseline rainfall, multiplied by 100%.
